title: select_channel returns out-of-bounds index for plans with <3 channels
description:
The guard `n = max(self.num_channels, 3)` combined with `1 + (h % (n - 1))` can return channel indices 1 or 2 for plans with only 1-2 channels. For a 2-channel plan (indices 0-1), select_channel returns 1 or 2, causing ValueError when accessing plan.channels[2]. The intent was to avoid div-by-zero when n=1, but max(...,3) over-corrects. Same bug duplicated at line 200 in the standalone function.

File: python/src/lichen/channel_plan.py
Line: 57
